name: @javaabu/onu
rules:
### Before writing code

- Look up a component's page before using it: `node_modules/@javaabu/onu/docs/<group>/<name>.md`, `onu_get_doc` in the MCP server, or the site's `llms.txt`. Each page has a **Props** table and an **Accessibility** section. Use only the props listed there.
- Prefer an Onu component over writing your own or using a shadcn/ui primitive directly. `llms.txt` lists every component with one line on what it is for. Only reach for `@javaabu/onu/primitives` (the shadcn/ui parts Onu is built on) to compose something Onu doesn't have.
- Don't add other UI kits (MUI, Chakra, Ant Design, Headless UI, a separate shadcn/ui copy) next to Onu.

### Setup

- One CSS entry: `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "@javaabu/onu/tailwind.css";` and, for the font pack, `@import "@javaabu/onu/fonts.css";`, which needs `npm install @fontsource-variable/inter @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono @fontsource-variable/noto-sans-thaana` first.
- Wrap the app once in `<ThemeProvider><OnuProvider>…</OnuProvider></ThemeProvider>`. `OnuProvider` sets `lang`, `dir` and density on `<html>`, so portals follow.
- Dhivehi: `locale={dv}` with `import { dv } from "@javaabu/onu/locales/dv"`, or `locale="dv"` to load it on demand. English needs no `locale`.
- Inertia or Next.js: pass the router's `Link` as `linkComponent` on `OnuProvider`; Onu's links and `href` props then use it.

### Imports

- Components, hooks and helpers come from `@javaabu/onu`. Heavy features have their own entry: `@javaabu/onu/charts`, `/maps`, `/editor`, `/calendar`, `/media`, `/query-builder`, `/export`, `/thaana`, `/icons/iconify`, `/icons/fontawesome`. The docs page's first code block shows the import.
- Never import from `@javaabu/onu/dist/...` or `@javaabu/onu/src/...`.

### Forms (Laravel)

- Put every control inside `FormField` with the field's `name` (bracket notation is fine, `items[0][name]`). `FormField` wires the label, help, errors and ARIA. Don't hand-write `<label>`, error text or `aria-describedby`.
- Use `Form` with an `onSubmit` that returns the request promise (axios, fetch or Inertia). It shows Laravel 422 errors under the fields, focuses the first one and shows the error summary. With Inertia, pass `errors={form.errors}` and `processing={form.processing}`.
- Submit with `SubmitButton` (spinner, no double submit), not a plain `Button type="submit"`.
- Pick the specific input: `EmailInput`, `PasswordInput`, `PhoneInput`, `NumberInput`, `DatePicker`, `ApiSelect` (Laravel paginated API), `InstantFileUpload`, and so on, rather than `TextInput type="…"`.
- Edit pages get `SaveBar`; index pages get `ListingPage` (or `DataTable` with `useListingState`).

### Dhivehi, Thaana and RTL

- Free-text fields that may hold Dhivehi take `thaana` (`<TextInput thaana />`, `<Textarea thaana />`), or use `ThaanaInput`. Never add `thaana` to email, password, URL, number, phone, OTP or code inputs; they stay LTR by design.
- Use logical Tailwind utilities only: `ms-*`/`me-*`, `ps-*`/`pe-*`, `start-*`/`end-*`, `text-start`/`text-end`, `border-s`/`border-e`, `rounded-s-*`/`rounded-e-*`. Never `ml-*`, `mr-*`, `pl-*`, `pr-*`, `left-*`, `right-*`, `text-left` or `text-right`. Flip transforms with `rtl:`.
- Sides are `side="start" | "end"`, not left/right.
- Format dates, numbers and money with `useFormatDate`, `useFormatNumber` and `useFormatCurrency` (MVR), not `toLocaleString` or hand-built strings. Numbers use Western digits in Dhivehi too.
- Built-in strings come from the locale. For your own strings use `useTranslation()` or your app's i18n, and override Onu's strings with `OnuProvider messages`.

### Styling and theming

- Brand colour: set `--onu-primary` (one variable re-themes everything). Use the theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`, `bg-card`, …), never fixed colours like `bg-blue-600` or hex values, so dark mode and themes keep working.
- Restyle with `className` (merged with tailwind-merge, yours wins) and `classNames={{ part: "…" }}` for parts. Reuse exported variants such as `buttonVariants`. Use `asChild` to render your own element. No `!important`, no inline styles for static values.
- Density (`compact` to `touch`) and dark mode come from the providers; don't hard-code heights or `dark:` colours on Onu components.

### Icons

- Use `<Icon name="search" />` and `startIcon="add"` / `endIcon="…"` props with semantic names, not imports from `lucide-react`. Give icons that carry meaning a `label`; icon-only buttons need an accessible name (`aria-label` or the component's `label` prop).
- Directional icons mirror in RTL on their own; don't flip them yourself.

### Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)

- Onu components already handle roles, focus and keyboard. Don't remove focus rings, add `tabIndex` to non-interactive elements, or replace buttons with clickable `div`s.
- Announce async results with `toast()`, `announce()` or `LiveRegion`; hide text visually with `VisuallyHidden`, not `display: none`.
- Confirm destructive actions with `confirm()` / `useConfirm()` or the item's `confirm` option, not `window.confirm`.

### Bundle size

- Import only what you use; every entry is tree-shaken. Keep charts, maps, the editor, the calendar and media in their own entries (and lazy routes when they are big).

pages.title: Introduction
pages.description: Onu is Javaabu's React UI component library.

pages.title: Installation & Setup
pages.description: First install the NPM package

sections.title: Guides
sections.description: Theming, RTL, Dhivehi, Thaana input, icons, fonts and more

pages.title: Design & density
pages.description: Onu's default look pairs a Proton Mail-style app shell with Ant Design 5 content elements: 14px text, 32px controls, 6px control corners and 8px cards, hairline borders, plain greys, and colour used for emphasis.

pages.title: Theming
pages.description: Onu's default theme pairs a Proton Mail-style app shell with Ant Design 5 content elements

pages.title: Dark mode
pages.description: Every Onu component has a dark variant. Dark mode turns on when an ancestor has the `dark` class or `data-theme="dark"`, so it works with any toggling approach.

pages.title: RTL
pages.description: Every Onu component works right-to-left with no extra props.

pages.title: Dhivehi & locales
pages.description: Onu ships with English (`en`) and Dhivehi (`dv`).

pages.title: Thaana input
pages.description: Onu can type Thaana from a Latin keyboard, so users don't need a Dhivehi keyboard installed.

pages.title: Icons
pages.description: Onu uses Lucide icons by default, with no setup.

pages.title: Fonts
pages.description: Onu's optional font pack. Install the three Latin and fallback fonts it loads from npm, then import it after `tailwind.css`

pages.title: Accessibility
pages.description: Onu targets WCAG 2.2 Level AA for every component, in light and dark mode and in both directions.

pages.title: Style overrides
pages.description: Every component can be restyled without forking it.

pages.title: Forms & Laravel validation
pages.description: Onu's form components are built around Laravel's conventions, so server validation errors show up under the right fields with no glue code.

pages.title: Inertia & Next.js
pages.description: Onu is plain React, so it works in Vite apps, Laravel + Inertia (React) and Next.js.

pages.title: AI assistants
pages.description: Onu's docs are written so AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT and others) can use them: every page is plain Markdown with a Props table and an Accessibility section, and there is a short list o…

pages.title: Rules for AI assistants
pages.description: Short rules for AI coding assistants (and people) writing UI with Onu.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.description: Screen-reader helpers: visually hidden text, live regions and announcements

pages.title: VisuallyHidden
pages.description: Content for screen readers only. It is taken out of the visual layout with Tailwind's `sr-only` but is still read out, and focusable content inside it stays in the tab order.

pages.title: LiveRegion
pages.description: An `aria-live` region: screen readers read its text whenever it changes, without moving focus.

pages.title: useAnnouncer and announce
pages.description: Announces messages to screen-reader users: "Row moved to position 3", "Settings saved", "4 results".

sections.title: Form scaffolding
sections.description: Forms, fields, labels, errors and buttons

pages.title: Form
pages.description: A `<form>` that handles the boring parts: label layout for every field, disabling fields while saving, server validation errors (Laravel 422) under each field, an error summary at the top, and moving focus to the firs…

pages.title: FormField
pages.description: A label, a control, help text and error messages, laid out stacked (label above) or inline (label beside).

pages.title: Form layout & errors
pages.description: Providers that configure every `FormField` inside them.

pages.title: FormGroup
pages.description: Lays out related fields in a responsive grid and sets their label layout.

pages.title: Fieldset / FormSection
pages.description: A titled section of a form: a real `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`, an optional description, and an optional collapse toggle.

pages.title: Label
pages.description: shadcn's `Label` with a required marker or an "(optional)" note.

pages.title: RequiredMarker
pages.description: The `*` shown after a required field's label.

pages.title: FieldErrors
pages.description: Error messages for one field, each with an error icon.

pages.title: ValidationSummary (AJAX validation errors)
pages.description: An error summary for the top of a form. It lists every error, and each one is a link that moves focus to its field.

pages.title: HelpText
pages.description: Supporting text under a control. `FormField` renders it from the `help` prop and links it with `aria-describedby`.

pages.title: FormContainer
pages.description: A card-style layout for a form: a header (title, description, actions), the body and a footer for the buttons.

pages.title: RepeatingGroup
pages.description: A list of repeated rows of fields (line items, family members, contact numbers) with Add, Remove and Move up / Move down.

pages.title: InlineEdit
pages.description: Text that turns into an input when clicked, for quick edits on detail pages and tables.

pages.title: AutosaveIndicator
pages.description: Shows whether changes are being saved automatically: idle, saving, saved (with relative time, "Saved 2 minutes ago") or error (with Retry).

pages.title: SaveBar
pages.description: The save bar for edit pages (REQUIREMENTS §25.9).

pages.title: useUnsavedChangesGuard
pages.description: Warns before leaving a page with unsaved changes (§25.9).

pages.title: FloatingSubmit
pages.description: A submit button that floats at the bottom of the screen while the form's main submit button is scrolled out of view, so a long form can be submitted from anywhere.

pages.title: SubmitButton
pages.description: A `type="submit"` `Button` that shows a spinner while the form is processing and ignores clicks until it finishes, so a form can't be submitted twice.

pages.title: Button
pages.description: Onu's button: shadcn's `Button` with a `loading` state, `startIcon` / `endIcon`, and extra `success` and `warning` variants.

pages.title: LinkButton
pages.description: A link that looks like a `Button`. It renders through the `linkComponent` set on `OnuProvider`, so it navigates with Inertia, Next.js or your router (R16.2).

pages.title: ButtonGroup
pages.description: Groups related buttons. By default the buttons are joined into one segmented control (shadcn's button group); `attached={false}` keeps them separate with a gap and lets them wrap.

pages.title: Auth forms
pages.description: Ready-made, presentational authentication forms: `SignInForm`, `RegisterForm`, `ForgotPasswordForm` and `ResetPasswordForm`.

pages.title: eFaas button
pages.description: The Sign in with eFaas button, styled after the eFaas brand guide (R16.7).

pages.title: eFaas logo
pages.description: The 22 official eFaas logos from eFaas's brand kit, unchanged, as one component.

sections.title: Text inputs
sections.description: Text, Thaana, number, phone, OTP and other inputs

pages.title: TextInput
pages.description: A single-line text input with optional addons and Thaana keyboard support.

pages.title: EmailInput
pages.description: An email address input. It sets `type="email"`, `inputMode="email"` (the email keyboard on phones) and `autocomplete="email"`, turns off auto-capitalisation and spell check, and is always left-to-right, even on a Dhiv…

pages.title: PasswordInput
pages.description: A password input with a show/hide button, a Caps Lock warning and an optional strength meter.

pages.title: SensitiveInput
pages.description: A read-only display for a secret such as an API key or client secret.

pages.title: CopyInput
pages.description: A read-only value with a copy button: share links, reference numbers, account numbers.

pages.title: NumberInput
pages.description: A numeric input with locale-aware formatting, `min` / `max` / `step`, and spinbutton keys.

pages.title: QuantityStepper
pages.description: A number with large − and + buttons, for cart quantities, tickets and guest counts.

pages.title: UnitInput
pages.description: A number with a unit add-on: either fixed text (`kg`, `MVR`, `%`) or a unit select (`m` / `km`).

pages.title: PhoneInput
pages.description: An international phone number input built on `react-phone-number-input` (libphonenumber).

pages.title: UrlInput
pages.description: A URL input. It sets `type="url"`, `inputMode="url"` and `autocomplete="url"`, is always left-to-right, and adds `https://` when the user leaves the field without a scheme (`javaabu.com` → `https://javaabu.com`).

pages.title: HiddenInput
pages.description: A hidden form value. Inside a `FormField` it takes the field's `id` and `name`, so server errors for that name show on the field like any other control.

pages.title: Textarea
pages.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content, with Thaana support and an optional character counter.

pages.title: ThaanaInput
pages.description: `ThaanaInput` and `ThaanaTextarea` are `TextInput` and `Textarea` with Thaana typing on and the Thaana/Latin toggle shown by default.

pages.title: ThaanaToggle
pages.description: The button that switches a field between Thaana and Latin typing.

pages.title: OtpInput
pages.description: A one-time code input built on shadcn's `input-otp`.

pages.title: SlugInput
pages.description: A slug generator, like `slugInput` in `@javaabu/js-utilities`.

pages.title: Autocomplete
pages.description: A free-text input with suggestions. The typed text is the value; suggestions only help fill it in (for a fixed list of choices, use a select).

pages.title: ColorPicker
pages.description: A colour picker built on React Aria's colour components.

pages.title: IconPicker
pages.description: An icon picker with search and a virtualised grid (TanStack Virtual), so thousands of icons stay fast.

pages.title: SignaturePad
pages.description: A signature pad built on `signature_pad`.

pages.title: TagsInput
pages.description: A chips input for keywords, topics and similar lists.

pages.title: QrCodeScanner
pages.description: A QR code scanner. It opens the camera with `getUserMedia`, decodes frames with the browser's `BarcodeDetector`, and loads the `barcode-detector` polyfill (ZXing in WebAssembly) only where the native API is missing (R…

sections.title: Date and time
sections.description: Date, time and range pickers and calendars

pages.title: DatePicker
pages.description: A date field that opens a calendar. Built on shadcn's `Calendar` (react-day-picker) inside a `Popover`, or a bottom-sheet `Drawer` on phones (R3.28).

pages.title: TimePicker
pages.description: A time field that opens large hour and minute steppers with ▲/▼, an AM/PM switch, a clock-face hour grid and a minute grid (REQUIREMENTS §25.2).

pages.title: DateTimePicker
pages.description: A calendar with a time chip underneath (REQUIREMENTS §25.3).

pages.title: DateRangePicker
pages.description: Two fields side by side, From and To, each opening a DatePicker (or a DateTimePicker with `withTime`).

pages.title: MonthPicker and YearPicker
pages.description: Pick a month (or a year) from a grid of 12 that zooms out to years and ranges of years.

pages.title: HijriDate
pages.description: Shows a date in the Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar, e.g.

pages.title: HijriDatePicker
pages.description: Picks a date on the Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar.

pages.title: MultipleDatePicker
pages.description: Picks any number of days from one calendar.

pages.title: WeekPicker
pages.description: Picks a whole week: clicking any day selects its week, hovering previews the week, and week numbers are shown.

pages.title: ReportingPeriodPicker
pages.description: Picks a monthly, quarterly, yearly or custom reporting period, with a configurable financial-year start.

pages.title: DateCalendar
pages.description: The calendar inside every Onu date picker, for use inline.

pages.title: TimePanel
pages.description: The steppers, clock-face hour grid and minute grid used inside TimePicker and DateTimePicker, for use inline (e.g.

pages.title: FullCalendar
pages.description: A full calendar with month, week, day and agenda views, built on FullCalendar v6 using only its MIT "standard" plugins (`daygrid`, `timegrid`, `list`, `interaction`; R4.3).

sections.title: Choice inputs
sections.description: Selects, checkboxes, radios, switches and pickers

pages.title: Select
pages.description: A select for short lists, built on shadcn's select (Radix).

pages.title: Searchable select
pages.description: A select with a search field: a field that opens a searchable list (shadcn Popover + Command; a bottom sheet on phones).

pages.title: Dependent select
pages.description: A select whose options depend on another field (atoll → island).

pages.title: API select
pages.description: A searchable select that loads its options from any API (REQUIREMENTS R16.5).

pages.title: Editable select
pages.description: A text field with a list of suggestions that also accepts anything the user types (a WAI-ARIA combobox with list autocomplete).

pages.title: Multi-select
pages.description: Pick several options. Selected values show as chips in the field (each with a remove button), the list has a "Select all" row for the visible options, and `max` caps the number of values.

pages.title: Dual listbox
pages.description: Two lists, "Available" and "Selected", with buttons to move items between them.

pages.title: Checkbox
pages.description: shadcn's checkbox plus a label, description and an indeterminate (mixed) state.

pages.title: Radio
pages.description: One radio button with a label, description and, in the card variant, media and an aside.

pages.title: Radio group
pages.description: A set of radios where one can be chosen (shadcn radio group).

pages.title: Switch
pages.description: shadcn's switch plus a label and description.

pages.title: Segmented control
pages.description: Pick one of a few options shown side by side (shadcn toggle group, single mode).

pages.title: Range slider
pages.description: A slider for one value or a range (shadcn slider), with marks, value labels and locale number formatting.

pages.title: Rating
pages.description: A star rating with optional half steps, a read-only display mode and full keyboard support.

pages.title: Payment method selector
pages.description: Choose how to pay: BML Transfer (bank transfer to a Bank of Maldives account, usually followed by a slip upload) and/or BML Connect (BML's online card gateway), as a radio group of large cards with BML's official logo…

pages.title: BML logos
pages.description: Bank of Maldives' official logos, supplied by BML, as React components (R16.8).

pages.title: Account switcher
pages.description: Switch between your own account and accounts you act for: organisations and delegated individuals (e.g.

pages.title: Image select
pages.description: A grid of image options: one choice (radio semantics) or several (`multiple`, checkbox semantics).

pages.title: Select with quick-create
pages.description: A searchable select that can create the option the user is looking for.

pages.title: FileInput
pages.description: A styled native file input. The real `<input type="file">` covers the trigger, so clicking, tapping, the keyboard (Enter/Space) and dropping a file onto it all work natively.

pages.title: MultipleFileInput
pages.description: A `FileInput` for several files: each pick adds to the list (duplicates are skipped), every file has a remove button, and an optional hint shows the limits with a live count ("3 of 5").

pages.title: InstantFileUpload
pages.description: Uploads each file as soon as it is chosen, with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and remove.

pages.title: UploadProgress
pages.description: A list of uploads, each with its name, size, progress bar, status (waiting, uploading, uploaded, failed, cancelled) and cancel / retry / remove buttons.

pages.title: DropzoneUploader
pages.description: A drag-and-drop zone built on `react-dropzone`, with a "Browse files" button as the keyboard and touch alternative, paste from the clipboard, validation messages, and an upload progress list when given an uploader.

pages.title: AdditionalFilesUpload
pages.description: Manages a record's attachments on an edit page: existing files can be removed (and restored before saving), and new files can be added, each with an optional display name and description.

pages.title: ImageInput
pages.description: Picks one image with a preview, and Replace / Remove buttons.

pages.title: AvatarUpload
pages.description: A circular avatar picker: shows the photo (or initials), opens a crop step after picking (using `ImageCropper`), and offers Change and Remove.

pages.title: ImageCropper
pages.description: Crops an image with `react-easy-crop`: drag or pinch to move and zoom, arrow keys to nudge, a zoom slider, rotation, aspect-ratio presets, and Blob/File output.

pages.title: MediaLister
pages.description: A media library: grid or list view, search, single or multiple selection, type icons and lazy thumbnails, with infinite or paged loading driven by props (fetch the data however you like).

pages.title: Gallery
pages.description: A responsive image grid or masonry layout.

pages.title: Lightbox
pages.description: A full-screen image viewer built on yet-another-react-lightbox: keyboard, swipe, pinch/double-tap/wheel zoom, captions and a counter, with a focus trap, focus return, translated labels and mirrored arrows in RTL.

pages.title: Carousel
pages.description: shadcn's Carousel (Embla) extended with RTL direction, translated controls, dot navigation, autoplay with a pause button, and slide announcements.

pages.title: AttachmentPreview
pages.description: A file attachment: thumbnail or type icon, name, type and size, with open, download and remove actions.

pages.title: DocumentDownload
pages.description: A downloadable document card with its type, size and a download link, optionally in several language versions (English and Dhivehi).

pages.title: MediaPlayer
pages.description: An accessible audio and video player built on Media Chrome: play/pause, seek, time, mute and volume, captions, playback speed and full screen, with keyboard shortcuts, translated labels and Onu theming.

pages.title: VideoEmbed
pages.description: A click-to-load YouTube or Vimeo embed (the "lite embed" pattern): it shows a thumbnail and a play button, and loads the privacy-enhanced player (`youtube-nocookie.com`, Vimeo with `dnt=1`) only when the user presses…

pages.title: FileIcon
pages.description: A coloured icon for a file's type (image, video, audio, PDF, document, spreadsheet, presentation, archive, text), detected from the MIME type or the file extension.

pages.title: QrCode
pages.description: A QR code generator. The text is encoded with `uqr` (MIT, zero dependencies) and Onu renders the SVG itself, so the dark modules use `currentColor` and follow theme tokens.

pages.title: WYSIWYG editor
pages.description: A rich text editor built on Tiptap (ProseMirror).

pages.title: Block editor
pages.description: A block-based editor (page builder) on Tiptap.

pages.title: Block renderer
pages.description: Renders block editor (or WYSIWYG) JSON to React without loading the editor.

pages.title: Code block
pages.description: Read-only code with Shiki syntax highlighting, a language label, a copy button and optional line numbers.

pages.title: Translations editor
pages.description: Edit translation keys side by side in English and Dhivehi (or any languages).

pages.title: Custom attribute fields
pages.description: Renders form fields from a schema, for custom attributes, settings or product specs, using Onu's inputs.

pages.title: ThaanaKeyboard (Tiptap)
pages.description: A Tiptap extension that types Thaana from a Latin keyboard through ProseMirror transactions rather than DOM edits (R13.2), so undo/redo, input rules and collaboration keep working.

pages.title: MapProvider
pages.description: Configures the map engine for every map inside it.

pages.title: MapView
pages.description: The base map. Put markers, shapes and layers inside it.

pages.title: MapPicker
pages.description: Pick a point: click the map, drag the pin, search a place, use the device location, or type the latitude and longitude.

pages.title: MapRadius
pages.description: A centre and a radius in metres: click to place the centre, drag the handles, or type the numbers.

pages.title: MapPolygon
pages.description: Draw and edit polygons (zones, plots, service areas).

pages.title: MapRoute
pages.description: Draw a route as a line (patrol path, ferry line, delivery route).

pages.title: LiveMap
pages.description: Markers that move as positions arrive, from props (polling) or a stream (WebSocket, SSE, Laravel Echo).

pages.title: MapNavigation
pages.description: Turn-by-turn style directions between stops: the route on the map, a summary, and a step list with Previous / Next.

pages.title: LocationCard
pages.description: A place at a glance: a static map thumbnail, the address, coordinates and an Open in Google Maps link.

pages.title: AddressInput
pages.description: Structured Maldivian address fields: atoll, island, road and house/building name, with an optional map pin.

pages.title: MapReplay
pages.description: Plays back a timestamped track (a vessel trip, a delivery run): play/pause, speed and a scrubber.

pages.title: MapInfoPanel
pages.description: Details of the selected marker: a side panel over the map on desktop and a bottom sheet on phones.

pages.title: RouteStopEditor
pages.description: An ordered list of stops synced with numbered markers.

pages.title: HeatmapLayer
pages.description: A density heatmap inside a `MapView`. On Google Maps it is deck.gl's `HeatmapLayer` through `GoogleMapsOverlay` (Google's own HeatmapLayer is deprecated and never used).

pages.title: ViewportMarkerMap
pages.description: Loads markers for the visible area through your fetcher and clusters them (`@googlemaps/markerclusterer`).

pages.title: MapLegendSwatch
pages.description: Colour and shape samples that match how layers are drawn, and `MapLegend`, a labelled list of them.

pages.title: BarChart
pages.description: A bar graph built on shadcn's chart (`ChartContainer` + Recharts).

pages.title: LineChart
pages.description: A line graph on shadcn's chart (Recharts).

pages.title: PieChart
pages.description: A pie or donut chart on shadcn's chart (Recharts).

pages.title: TimeSeriesChart
pages.description: A line, area or bar chart on a real time axis, optionally stacked.

pages.title: PeriodComparisonChart
pages.description: Compares the current period with the previous one: headline totals with a delta percentage and an up/down indicator, the two periods overlaid (previous dashed, or as muted bars), and a table with the change per step.

pages.title: Sparkline
pages.description: A tiny inline line or area chart with no axes, labels or tooltip, for trends in tables, stat tiles and text.

pages.title: StatTile
pages.description: KPI tiles: a label, a formatted value, a delta (arrow + sign + semantic colour), an optional icon and sparkline, and a loading skeleton.

pages.title: DeltaIndicator
pages.description: A change indicator: an arrow icon, a signed percentage and a semantic colour.

pages.title: MapChart
pages.description: A choropleth map: regions shaded by value on Google Maps, drawn with a deck.gl `GeoJsonLayer` (`GoogleMapsOverlay`).

sections.title: Listing pages
sections.description: Tables, filters, pagination and listing tools

pages.title: ListingPage
pages.description: A complete index page, laid out as REQUIREMENTS §25.6 describes: a header with the title, the main action and secondary links (Trash, with a dot when it isn't empty), status tabs, a toolbar with the search box, Filter…

pages.title: useListingState
pages.description: State for an index page — search, sort, page, rows per page, filters, view, selection and column visibility — with the rules from REQUIREMENTS §25.6 built in

pages.title: DataTable
pages.description: The listing table, built on TanStack Table v9 (column model, visibility and selection) and shadcn's `Table`.

pages.title: FilterPanel
pages.description: The Filters button and its panel (REQUIREMENTS §25.7): a dropdown on desktop and a bottom sheet on phones.

pages.title: ActiveFilterChips
pages.description: One pill per applied filter under the toolbar (REQUIREMENTS §25.7): "Status: Active", "Created: 1 Mar → 31 Mar", "Created: from 1 Mar".

pages.title: SearchBox
pages.description: The search box of an index page. Typing does nothing until the user presses Enter or leaves the box after changing the text (REQUIREMENTS §25.6), so a request isn't sent for every keystroke.

pages.title: Pagination
pages.description: Pagination for listings, laid out like Ant Design's: "Showing 26–50 of 312 users" at the start, then numbered pages between the previous and next arrows, then a rows-per-page select (10 / 25 / 50 / 100).

pages.title: PerPage
pages.description: A rows-per-page select (shadcn `Select`), used by `Pagination`.

pages.title: BulkActionBar
pages.description: The bulk action bar (REQUIREMENTS §25.6).

pages.title: RowActions
pages.description: The ⋯ menu at the end of a row (REQUIREMENTS §25.6), on shadcn's `DropdownMenu`.

pages.title: RecordActionsMenu
pages.description: Actions in a record page header (e.g. Logs, Approve, Delete — REQUIREMENTS §25.8).

pages.title: EmptyState
pages.description: Empty states for listings (REQUIREMENTS §25.6), on shadcn's `Empty`

pages.title: ViewSwitcher
pages.description: Switches a listing between table, list, grid and board views.

pages.title: ColumnVisibility
pages.description: A "Columns" menu with a checkbox per column, to show or hide table columns.

pages.title: FilterTabs
pages.description: Status tabs above a listing, with counts: "All 312 · Active 280 · Banned 32".

pages.title: ExportMenu
pages.description: An Export button with a menu of formats (CSV, Excel, PDF).

pages.title: exportRows (client-side export)
pages.description: Builds a CSV, Excel or PDF file in the browser from the rows you already have, for apps without a server export.

pages.title: FilterSubmit
pages.description: Submit and Reset buttons for a classic filter form, e.g.

pages.title: ListView
pages.description: Records as a vertical list: media (avatar, icon), title, description and details, with optional checkboxes and a ⋯ menu per item.

pages.title: GridView
pages.description: Records as a responsive grid of cards. Columns follow the space available (`repeat(auto-fill, minmax(…))`), not the viewport, so the grid also works in a sidebar or a narrow column.

pages.title: KanbanBoard
pages.description: A board of columns with cards that move between them, on `@dnd-kit/react`.

pages.title: TreeView
pages.description: A tree of records (folders, categories, atolls and islands, org units) on React Aria's `Tree`, which implements the WAI-ARIA tree grid pattern.

pages.title: SortableList
pages.description: A list the user can put in order (menu items, steps, priorities), on `@dnd-kit/react`: drag the handle with a mouse or by touch (press and hold), use the keyboard on the handle, or use the Move up / Move down buttons.

pages.title: ReorderableTable
pages.description: Drag-and-drop row reordering for tables (route stops, menu items, priorities), on `@dnd-kit/react` and shadcn's `Table`.

pages.title: EditableDataGrid
pages.description: A spreadsheet-like table for quick edits (order lines, stock counts, rates), following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern.

pages.title: SearchResults
pages.description: Search results grouped by type (Services, News, Pages), with a count per group and the search words highlighted.

pages.title: LoadMore
pages.description: A Load more button for lists and grids, with "Showing 1–20 of 312" and an announcement of how many items arrived.

pages.title: FilterConditionBuilder
pages.description: Advanced filters as conditions — "Status is Active and Island is one of Malé, Hulhumalé" — on `react-querybuilder`, with Onu controls (native selects, inputs, buttons, checkbox), translations and an RTL-aware layout.

pages.title: Modal
pages.description: A dialog with a simple `title` / `description` / `footer` API, built on shadcn's `Dialog` (Radix).

pages.title: ConfirmDialog
pages.description: Asks the user to confirm an action, built on shadcn's `AlertDialog`.

pages.title: SlideOver
pages.description: A panel that slides in from the side, for detail views, quick edits and filters.

pages.title: BottomSheet
pages.description: A pull-up panel anchored to the bottom of the screen.

pages.title: PopoverPanel
pages.description: A non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, for small forms, filters and extra details: Onu's simple-API popover.

pages.title: Tip
pages.description: A tooltip that also works on touch screens.

pages.title: ActionMenu
pages.description: A dropdown menu of actions built from an `items` array, on shadcn's `DropdownMenu` (Radix).

pages.title: ContextActionMenu
pages.description: A context menu (right-click menu) built from the same `items` as `ActionMenu`, on shadcn's `ContextMenu` (Radix).

pages.title: CommandPalette
pages.description: A ⌘K / Ctrl+K command palette for jumping to pages, records and commands from the keyboard.

pages.title: Spinner
pages.description: A spinning loading indicator with a screen-reader label.

pages.title: Skeleton presets
pages.description: Ready-made skeletons for the most common shapes: `SkeletonText`, `SkeletonCard` and `SkeletonTable`.

pages.title: PlaceholderInput
pages.description: A skeleton shaped like a form field (label, control and optional help text), for forms whose values are still loading.

pages.title: LoadingOverlay
pages.description: Covers a container (a card, table or form) while it loads or saves.

pages.title: PageProgress
pages.description: A thin bar at the top of the page that shows a navigation or long request is in progress, like NProgress.

pages.title: ProgressBar
pages.description: A determinate or indeterminate progress bar with an optional label and value text, in semantic colours.

pages.title: AppLayout
pages.description: The application shell: a Skip to content link, the sidebar, a header, the main content, an optional footer and an optional phone bottom navigation.

pages.title: AppHeader
pages.description: The top bar of an app or portal: an optional sidebar toggle, a logo, the main content (page title, breadcrumbs, navigation or search) and actions at the inline end.

pages.title: TopNav
pages.description: Horizontal main navigation for headers, built on shadcn's `navigation-menu`.

pages.title: MenuBar
pages.description: A desktop-style application menu bar (File, Edit, View …) described as data.

pages.title: MegaMenu
pages.description: Header navigation whose items open wide panels with several columns of links (each with an optional icon and description) and an optional featured area.

pages.title: AppSidebar
pages.description: The app's main sidebar with a simple `items` / `groups` API: icons, badges, nested items and the active state from the current URL.

pages.title: AppSwitcher
pages.description: The app switcher next to the logo, like Proton's grid button: a menu of the products in a suite, each on a brand-tinted tile.

pages.title: SideNav
pages.description: A vertical navigation list that works on its own (settings pages, documentation, account pages) and inside drawers: groups, icons, badges, descriptions and collapsible nested items.

pages.title: BottomNav
pages.description: Phone bottom navigation: three to five destinations with icons and short labels, badges and the active state.

pages.title: SiteFooter
pages.description: The footer for portals and public pages: brand and description, link columns, social links, a copyright line, legal links and a slot for a `LanguageSwitcher`.

pages.title: PageTitle
pages.description: The page header of index, view and edit pages (§25.6, §25.8): the title, the main action button, and secondary links where a small dot marks e.g.

pages.title: Breadcrumbs
pages.description: A breadcrumb trail built on shadcn's `breadcrumb` (§25.8): every part is a link except the last, which is the current page.

pages.title: Section
pages.description: A page section with a heading, description and actions.

pages.title: Card
pages.description: shadcn's `Card`, extended. Without the new props it renders exactly like the shadcn card, so `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`, `CardContent` and `CardFooter` still compose as before.

pages.title: Tabs
pages.description: shadcn's `Tabs` (Radix, WAI-ARIA tabs), extended with an `items` API, icons, counts and a tab list that scrolls sideways on phones.

pages.title: NavTabs
pages.description: Link-based tabs for record pages (§25.8): "Profile", "Edit", "Activity (12)".

pages.title: StackedTabs
pages.description: Vertical tabs for settings-style pages: the tab list sits at the inline start with the panel beside it.

pages.title: Accordion
pages.description: shadcn's `Accordion` (Radix, WAI-ARIA accordion), extended with an `items` API and visual variants.

pages.title: Wizard
pages.description: A multi-step flow (application wizards, onboarding): a step list with each step's status, Back / Next buttons with per-step validation, jumping back to completed steps, a compact "Step 2 of 4" header with a progress b…

pages.title: Timeline
pages.description: A vertical timeline for status trackers and activity histories.

pages.title: Divider
pages.description: A separator line built on shadcn's `Separator`, optionally with a label in the middle, at the start or at the end.

pages.title: LanguageSwitcher
pages.description: Switches between languages using their native names (English, ދިވެހި).

pages.title: ThemeToggle
pages.description: Light / dark / system switch using `useTheme()` from `ThemeProvider` (R10.3).

pages.title: NotificationCenter
pages.description: A bell button with the unread count that opens the notification list: a popover on desktop and a bottom sheet (vaul drawer) on phones.

pages.title: UserProfile
pages.description: The signed-in user's avatar, name and role (or email), opening a menu with Profile, Settings, your own items and Sign out.

pages.title: Logo
pages.description: The product or organisation logo with separate light and dark images, an optional wordmark, linking home.

pages.title: UsageMeter
pages.description: A quota meter for the bottom of the sidebar, like Proton's storage meter: a labelled bar with "used / total", an optional link (e.g.

pages.title: SkipLink
pages.description: A "Skip to content" link (R14.4). Render it as the first focusable element on the page: it is visually hidden until it receives keyboard focus, then moves focus to the main content.

pages.title: BackToTop
pages.description: A floating "Back to top" button that appears after scrolling.

pages.title: MasonryGrid
pages.description: A masonry layout with CSS columns (no JavaScript layout): items of different heights pack into columns.

pages.title: OverlayMenu
pages.description: A full-screen overlay menu for portals, learning sites and kiosks.

pages.title: Hero
pages.description: The opening block of a portal or content page (R3.7): a heading, lead text, calls to action, an optional search field, and either media beside the text or a photo behind it.

pages.title: FeatureGrid
pages.description: A responsive grid of features or services (R3.7): each item has an icon, a title, a description and an optional link.

sections.title: Display and feedback
sections.description: Badges, alerts, toasts and display components

pages.title: DescriptionList
pages.description: Label–value pairs for record views ("Email: jane@example.com").

pages.title: StatusBadge
pages.description: A status label that always pairs colour with an icon and text, so colour is never the only signal (R14.6).

pages.title: Tag
pages.description: A compact label (chip) for categories, keywords and filters.

pages.title: UserAvatar
pages.description: A person's picture with an initials fallback that handles English and Dhivehi names, sizes, shapes and a presence dot.

pages.title: UserAvatarGroup
pages.description: Overlapping avatars with a "+N" button that lists everyone else.

pages.title: KeyboardKey
pages.description: Shows a key or keyboard shortcut using shadcn's `Kbd`.

pages.title: Callout (Alert)
pages.description: An alert box for messages that need attention: info, success, warning or destructive, with a title, description, actions and an optional dismiss button.

pages.title: Notice
pages.description: A subtle inline notice: a short line of supporting text with an icon, quieter than a Callout.

pages.title: AnnouncementBar
pages.description: A full-width bar at the top of the page for site-wide news.

pages.title: CookieConsent
pages.description: A cookie banner with a preferences dialog.

pages.title: Toast
pages.description: Short notifications, using sonner (shadcn's toast).

pages.title: ConditionalLink
pages.description: Renders a link only when there is somewhere to go and the user may go there; otherwise renders the same content as plain text.

pages.title: ConditionalDisplay
pages.description: Shows/hides or enables/disables part of a form depending on another field's value.

pages.title: PublishBox
pages.description: The "Publish" panel of a content editor: status, visibility and publish date, with Preview, Save draft and Publish actions.

pages.title: LastEditedBy
pages.description: "Last edited by Aishath Shiuna · 5 minutes ago", with a small avatar.

pages.title: RelativeDate
pages.description: A date shown relative to now ("just now", "5 minutes ago", "3 days ago", "in 2 hours"), as specified in REQUIREMENTS §25.5.

pages.title: Countdown
pages.description: Counts down to a date in days, hours, minutes and seconds, with tabular numbers (R7.5).

pages.title: ActivityFeed
pages.description: A log of who did what and when: grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, 3 October 2026), with actor avatars, relative timestamps and a "Load more" button.

pages.title: CommentThread
pages.description: A discussion with nested replies. People can edit and delete their own comments, and the composer can type Thaana (`thaana` prop, R13.3).

pages.title: Notes
pages.description: Internal notes on a record: who wrote what and when, with an add-note box that can type Thaana (`thaana` prop, R13.3) and delete with confirmation.

pages.title: IconText
pages.description: An icon next to a short piece of text, aligned and sized together: meta rows such as location, date or phone number.

pages.title: ShareButtons
pages.description: Share a page. Where the device supports the Web Share API (most phones), one Share button opens the system share sheet.

pages.title: PrintButton and BackButton
pages.description: Two small helpers for detail pages, receipts and certificates.

pages.title: MiniCalendar
pages.description: A compact, read-only month calendar with event dots, for portal sidebars and dashboards ("Upcoming events").

pages.title: ContentCard
pages.description: A card for news articles, services and events: image, title, excerpt, date, category, extra meta and a link.

pages.title: Error pages
pages.description: Full-page error states with a code, title, message, illustration and actions (Go home, Go back, Try again), translated into English and Dhivehi.
